facts.text: I am looking for inspiration for my next painting project.
I just finished an online course on color theory today.
I am excited to apply what I learned from the color theory course to my work.
I want to explore Impressionism and Fauvism.
I have always been drawn to vibrant and expressive colors.
I want to use soft brushstrokes and bold colors.
I am thinking of doing a cityscape painting.
I am thinking of painting a street scene or a building.
I want to capture vibrant colors and energy of the city using Impressionist and Fauvist techniques.
I have always been fascinated by the cityscapes of Paris.
I think I will set my painting in Paris.
I want to paint along the Seine River.
I want to use soft, feathery brushstrokes to suggest a misty atmosphere and the play of light on the water.
I want to incorporate bold, geometric forms to depict buildings and streets.
I am thinking of using a combination of blues and greens to evoke a sense of calm.
I want to add pops of bright color to capture the energy of the city.
I was thinking about the color palette to make it more vibrant and expressive.
I just finished an online course on color theory today.
I want to make sure I use colors that will really pop and capture the energy of the city.
I think I will use a Split-Complementary harmony scheme for my painting.
I like using a bold, vibrant color and its split-complementary colors to create contrast and energy.
I am thinking of using a blue-green color as my central color.
I am pairing the blue-green central color with orange-red and yellow-orange as split-complementary colors.
I want to use these colors in a way that will really pop and capture the energy of the city.
